items.title: Do bats really have bad eyesight?
items.concept: Replace the blind-bat myth with a comparison of bat vision and echolocation across different species and tasks.

script.hook: Bats are not blind.
script.narration: Bats are not blind. Watch the visible clue first. Replace the blind-bat myth with a comparison of bat vision and echolocation across different species and tasks. Many species use useful vision alongside echolocation, shifting between channels as light, distance, and task change. Echolocation is an extra sense—not proof that the eyes do not work.
script.payoff: Echolocation is an extra sense—not proof that the eyes do not work.
